sources.title: ampixa/mitra-s37 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Request access to mitra S37 Access is reviewed by hand and granted for research only. This artifact belongs to a research system that rewrites LLM-written text in the style of named human writers, so that AI-text detectors may judge it human. Access is granted for research on AI-text detection, robustness of detectors, and style transfer.
